name: Executioner’s Blow
body:
You lash out during battle, slashing your opponent’s neck, stabbing through the eye, or striking another vital area.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Coup de Grace, Power Attack

Benefit: Once per day, with any melee weapon and as a full-round action, you may make a coup de grace attempt on an opponent as if that opponent was helpless.
